description:
Saebyuk ends up liking high school girl Kyungi who he meets everyday at the bus stop. As his feelings become deeper and turns into a one-sided love, Saebyuk turns into a girl because of the hormone resonance disorder. Kyungi appears to be interested in female-turned Saebyuk and approaches Saebyuk, with the two becoming friends.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4622994), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/52071299), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498011736), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000047260), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/wkrtkfkd), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/if_i_do_unrequited_love), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H038914868), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H038914868), [Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/episode/5150)
